headline: Tech stocks tumble after midterms on AI regulation fears
summary: Major tech stocks fell sharply after the US midterm elections, with the Nasdaq on track for its worst day in 18 months, down as much as 5%, on fears the AI industry and data center construction will face tougher regulation and scrutiny.

claims.statement: Major tech stocks fell sharply following the US midterm election results.

sources.quote: US tech shares fall sharply as investors bet on AI slowdown after Democrats’ election triumph
Major tech stocks plunge as US midterms add to fears of AI slowdown

claims.statement: The Nasdaq was on track for its worst day in 18 months, down as much as 5% on Thursday.

sources.quote: Nasdaq heading for its worst day in 18 months
after slumping by up to 5% on Thursday

claims.statement: The selloff reflects fears of tougher regulation and scrutiny of the AI industry and data centers after the midterms.

sources.quote: amid growing signs that the artificial intelligence industry will face tougher regulation because of the midterm election results
Markets have been reacting to possible tougher scrutiny of data centre construction and the AI industry following the US midterms.
